title: Add autonomy environment preflight
summary: Autonomous runs can now report alpha readiness blockers, but the autonomy loop itself still lacks a focused preflight that tells an agent whether local identity, Git metadata write access, and push attribution are usable before starting a slice. Add a read-only preflight report for autonomous sessions.
expectedFailureModes: Autonomous sessions start implementation despite an environment that cannot stage or commit.
The preflight hides GitHub push attribution blockers and encourages unsafe remote writes.
The preflight leaks machine-local paths in machine-readable output.
nextAction: Add an autonomy preflight command with text and JSON output, include Git write-access and identity blockers, document it in the autonomous workflow, and validate the expected local blocker path.
